note: Reviewed handovers for the subdivision record (data/hist-admin{1,2,3}.js). `found` is every succession OpenHistoricalMap ties by ONE event (the last row of one unit and the first row of another carry the same end_date:event / start_date:event) whose two statements name different years — refreshed by node scripts/build-hist-admin1.mjs --edges. `reviewed` moves both edges to a day Wikidata states for one of the two units AND the historical record (`history`) agrees with; the rows keep upstream's own words and carry the correction beside them (`dates[id].<edge>.corrected`). `refuted` leaves a finding as upstream wrote it, with the reason. `facts` is what Wikidata states at day precision for the reviewed units. Gate: npm run check:histfidelity. See scripts/histadmin/edges.mjs.

reviewed.history: The Ryukyu Disposition: the Meiji government's order abolishing Ryukyu Domain was delivered at Shuri on 27 March 1879 and Okinawa Prefecture was proclaimed on 4 April 1879, the day Wikidata gives for the domain's dissolution (Q707474 P576). Upstream's 1879 for the domain is the event's year; its 1880 for the prefecture is not.

cadenceBasis.observed: estimate, not measured per class: Wikidata is edited continuously and its Query Service reflects an edit within minutes, so any day can change what a query answers
cadenceBasis.expires: if the builders read a Wikidata dump or a frozen snapshot instead of the live Query Service

calendar.note: Dates OpenHistoricalMap states to the day or the month before a calendar regime adopted the Gregorian calendar, on that regime's ground (Japan: the Tenpō lunisolar calendar until 明治5年12月2日; 明治6年1月1日 = 1873-01-01). `found` is every such statement, with the ways the vector tiles draw that relation with — refreshed by node scripts/build-hist-admin1.mjs --edges. `reviewed` converts upstream's lunisolar digits to the Gregorian day (`at`; a month is its Gregorian span «first/last») from the Japanese date (`wareki`) a cited revision states; applied to the shipped rows beside upstream's words (`dates[id].<edge>.corrected`) and to the tier's tile `lines`. `refuted` lists statements that already are the Gregorian day. Gate: npm run check:histfidelity. See scripts/histadmin/calendar.mjs.

reviewed.history: 犬上県 was merged into 滋賀県 on 明治5年9月28日, which is 30 October 1872 (ja.wikipedia «犬上県», oldid 107421225: «9月28日（1872年10月30日） - 滋賀県に合併»). Upstream wrote the lunisolar month and day as 1872-09-28, a month early.
Upstream ends 近江国 on the last day before the merged 滋賀県 of 明治5年9月28日 (30 October 1872); that day is 明治5年9月27日, 29 October 1872. Its 1872-09-27 is the lunisolar month and day written as Gregorian.

帯江沖新田村 was renamed 帯江新田村 in 明治3年11月 (ja.wikipedia «茶屋町 (岡山県)», oldid 104541819, writes «1870年（明治3年）11月»; OpenHistoricalMap cites 改訂版 茶屋町史, 1989, pp. 36, 47). That lunisolar month ran from 22 December 1870 to 20 January 1871; upstream's 1870-11 is the lunisolar month number written as a Gregorian month, and no day within it is stated.

The Meiji government made the Ryukyu kingdom 琉球藩 by the rescript handed to the Ryukyuan envoys on 明治5年9月14日, 16 October 1872 (ja.wikipedia «琉球藩», oldid 110209346: «明治5年9月14日（1872年10月16日）»; Wikidata Q707474 P571 states 1872-10-16). Upstream wrote the lunisolar month and day as 1872-09-14.

refuted.note: The day 廃藩置県 was proclaimed, 明治4年7月14日, is 29 August 1871 (ja.wikipedia «廃藩置県», oldid 111035138: «明治4年7月14日（1871年8月29日）»); upstream already writes the Gregorian day. Whether a ritsuryō province or circuit ended that day is a separate question of the record, not of its calendar.
The first 仙台県 was set up by 廃藩置県 on 明治4年7月14日, 29 August 1871 (ja.wikipedia «廃藩置県», oldid 111035138) — upstream already writes the Gregorian day.

The first 仙台県 ends the day before the prefectural consolidation of 明治4年11月2日 (13 December 1871; ja.wikipedia «宮城県», oldid 111213613: «明治4年11月2日（1871年12月13日）»), i.e. 明治4年11月1日 = 12 December 1871 — upstream already writes the Gregorian day.
The consolidated 仙台県 of 明治4年11月2日 is 13 December 1871 (ja.wikipedia «宮城県», oldid 111213613) — upstream already writes the Gregorian day.
仙台県 was renamed 宮城県 on 明治5年1月8日, 16 February 1872 (ja.wikipedia «宮城県», oldid 111213613: «明治5年1月8日（1872年2月16日）») — upstream already writes the Gregorian day.
